summary: Architectural roadmap and execution plan for rebuilding FM Music into a full-featured native Android music streaming client (MetroList, InnerTune, and OuterTune style). Covers Kotlin & Jetpack Compose UI, Media3 MediaSession background service with notification lockscreen controls, InnerTube/Piped audio stream extraction, Room database for offline downloads and playlists, synchronized time-synced lyrics, and sleep timer.
